# OutageRadar

> Live status board for fifteen AI services (ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Grok/xAI, Mistral, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Cohere, Groq, Hugging Face, Together AI, Fireworks AI, OpenRouter, GitHub Copilot, DeepInfra). Each service shows its official status feed plus OutageRadar's own independent check of its API server, every 5 minutes, and a log of recent incidents. OutageRadar is independent and not affiliated with any service listed.

How to read it: "Official status" is what the provider publishes. "Our check" is OutageRadar asking the provider's API server for a reply; a reply (even "needs a key") means the server is up, not that the AI is answering. Gemini, DeepSeek and OpenRouter publish no status feed, so only our check is shown for them, marked "our check only". When data is older than 15 minutes, every service shows Unknown rather than a guess. All times are UTC.

- [Is Groq down?](https://liveoutageradar.com/status/groq/): Groq status and outage history

Each service page except GitHub Copilot's also has an "If X is down: switch to a backup" section: OpenAI-library code for other providers (OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, xAI, DeepSeek), each with its live status. No referral links.

## Outage alerts

- [Outage alerts in Discord or Slack](https://liveoutageradar.com/alerts/): free alerts for any of the services above, posted to a Discord or Slack channel through a webhook. No account or email; one confirmation message first; unsubscribe link in every alert.

## API error pages

What common AI API errors mean, whether the provider or the caller is at fault, and what to do, with that provider's live status on each page. Facts come from each provider's own docs (last checked Nov 10, 2026).

- [All API errors](https://liveoutageradar.com/errors/)
- [Claude API error 529: overloaded_error](https://liveoutageradar.com/errors/claude-529-overloaded/)
- [Claude API error 429: rate_limit_error](https://liveoutageradar.com/errors/claude-429-rate-limit/)
- [OpenAI API error 503: server_is_overloaded](https://liveoutageradar.com/errors/openai-503-overloaded/)
- [OpenAI API error 429: rate limit reached or slow_down](https://liveoutageradar.com/errors/openai-429-rate-limit/)
- [OpenAI: You exceeded your current quota (insufficient_quota)](https://liveoutageradar.com/errors/openai-insufficient-quota/)
- [Gemini API error 429: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED](https://liveoutageradar.com/errors/gemini-429-resource-exhausted/)
- [Gemini API error 503: UNAVAILABLE](https://liveoutageradar.com/errors/gemini-503-unavailable/)
- [DeepSeek API error 503: Server Overloaded](https://liveoutageradar.com/errors/deepseek-503-server-overloaded/)

## Data

- https://data.liveoutageradar.com/status.json: current status of every service (overall, official status, our check, last incident). Refreshed every 5 minutes.
- https://data.liveoutageradar.com/feed.xml: RSS 2.0 feed of incidents across all services, newest first. One item per incident, updated in place when it ends.
- https://data.liveoutageradar.com/feed/<id>.xml: the same for one service (ids as in the page addresses above, e.g. feed/claude.xml).
- https://data.liveoutageradar.com/incidents.json: each service's incident log, newest first (start, end, worst state, whether the provider confirmed it). Logging started November 8, 2026.

## Notes

- Incident times are when OutageRadar's checker saw the change (within 5 minutes), not the provider's own timestamps.
- An incident marked "our check only" was not confirmed by the provider's status page.
- Privacy: https://liveoutageradar.com/privacy.html
- Contact: contact@liveoutageradar.com
